_doc: Limner (Studio /limner): icons and hero portraits. A prompt = style.prefix + category.prefix + subject + category.suffix + style.suffix. Subjects: entries[<cat>/<id>].subject (Eric's edit) > subjects[<cat>][<id>] (drafts) > a draft made from the game's name and text. Finish = what turns a kept master into the exported image (re-run without the GPU). See the vault note Art - Limner.

pixel.suffix: , dark fantasy dungeon crawler, single object centered, plain white background, 32-bit pixel art

items.name: Items
items.hint: The game's base items without a slot (consumables, tools, keys, loose trinkets), plus your own (+ Add).

gear.name: Gear
gear.hint: Every equippable base item (armour, weapons, held, trinkets), plus fallbacks: cloth / leather / plate per armour slot and one per weapon type. Add your own with + Add.

classes.name: Classes
classes.hint: One emblem per class (the creator's class grid, the hero panel).

statuses.name: Statuses
statuses.hint: Small badges over heroes and monsters: read at 32 px.

damageTypes.name: Damage types
damageTypes.hint: One glyph per damage type; its colour also leads the skill placeholders.

skills.name: Skills
skills.hint: Placeholders per damage type (active and passive) until each class wave has its final skills.

portraits.name: Portraits
portraits.hint: The static set players pick from when making a hero: archetype × look × male/female.
portraits.prefix: close-up bust portrait from the chest up,

ui.name: UI
ui.hint: Menu screens, buttons and HUD icons. Add your own with + Add.

monsters.name: Monsters
monsters.hint: A portrait per monster (the turn-order bar, hover cards). Exported with the hero portraits, archetype: monster.
monsters.prefix: close-up portrait from the chest up,

npcs.name: NPCs
npcs.hint: Friendly NPCs' portraits (the shop window). Exported with the hero portraits, archetype: npc.
npcs.prefix: close-up bust portrait from the chest up,

tokens.name: Tokens
tokens.hint: Board tokens for monsters and NPCs: one full-body 3/4 standee, facing right (Mirror in the finish when it faces left), feet at the bottom. The game mirrors it for facing and animates it.
tokens.prefix: full body character standee, three-quarter view facing right, standing on the ground, the whole figure in frame from head to feet,

beast.prefix: full body side view facing right, the whole monster in frame,

mass.prefix: low and wide, seen from the side, the whole thing in frame,

healer.name: Healer
healer.summary: Holy and forbidden healers: back-line ritual priests with censers and candles, front-line zealots with mace and shield, occultists who drain life with blood magic.

looks.priest: ritual priest in hooded white and gold robes holding a smoking censer, candlelight
looks.zealot: zealot crusader in battered plate with a holy mace, a faint golden halo
looks.occultist: occultist in dark ritual robes with a bloodied dagger and glowing crimson runes

tank.name: Tank
tank.summary: Walls and commanders: knights who take the hit and send it back, warlords who rally the party, battle-mages who hold monsters back with fear and barriers.

looks.bastion: bastion knight in heavy dented plate armour with a huge tower shield
looks.overlord: overlord warlord in a crested helm and fur mantle raising a tattered war banner
looks.dominator: dominator battle-mage in dark armour, a staff crackling with violet barrier magic

support.name: Support
support.summary: Brewers, keepers and beast-tamers: alchemists with bandoliers of elixirs, nature wardens with totems and vines, beast masters with their war-cats.

looks.alchemist: alchemist in a leather apron with brass goggles and bandoliers of glowing flasks
looks.warden: warden druid in moss-green robes with antler headdress, vines and a carved totem
looks.beastmaster: beast master in furs and leather with a coiled whip and a snarling war-cat at the shoulder

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.summary: Death, elements and the long shot: necromancers with rot and a skeleton guard, elementalists with fire, frost and lightning, hooded snipers with bow and musket.

looks.necromancer: necromancer in black tattered robes with a bone staff and green rot flames
looks.elementalist: elementalist with fire, frost and lightning swirling around the hands
looks.sniper: sniper ranger in a hooded weathered green-brown leather cloak with a long flintlock musket

melee.name: Melee
melee.summary: Up close: spell blades with rune-etched swords, weapon masters with huge two-handers, void reapers who strike from the shadows with twin daggers.

looks.spellblade: spell blade with a rune-etched sword wreathed in arcane fire
looks.weaponmaster: scarred weapon master gladiator with a greatsword over the shoulder
looks.voidreaper: void reaper assassin holding twin daggers, face lit from one side by violet light, violet shadow wisps around them
